withdrawn_reviewer_errors.item: Opening summary catalogue numbers and darkness definition
withdrawn_reviewer_errors.correction: Withdrawn 12,135,193 proteins, 99.6% known phyla, 87.9% unnamed species, joint UniRef50+Pfam darkness definition, and 'cinco' typo. Submitted source reports 551 soil samples (549 assembled), 5,438 species representatives across 51 GTDB R232 phyla (187 with species assignment; first empty rank at order 11, family 142, genus 1,343, species 3,755), 753,305,533 predicted proteins, 449,265,306 90%-identity cluster representatives, sequence darkness defined by UniRef50 (2026_01) absence alone (69,938,628 assembly-wide; 4,292,446 of 43,423,322 genome-resolved; 106,042 admitted recurrent families with 536,437 members), and Pfam as a downstream screen.

Withdrawn claim that cropping directly establishes global length normalisation and unconfident regions as the mechanism. Cropping is a joint intervention changing sequence extent, length-dependent score normalisation, and retrieval opportunity.

Withdrawn 'only standard external release' and 'held confidential until publication' phrasing. Whole-paper submission readiness and raw-to-final reproducibility remain bounded by 78 missing raw-file paths, 302 permission failures, unverified duplicate-run merge commands, incomplete historical claim migration, pending MIMAG MAG deposition and release DOI, and unconfirmed public/reviewer access to ENA PRJEB125153 (554 runs from 551 samples, recorded release date 1 November 2026, not verified to contain MAGs).

withdrawn_reviewer_errors.item: Laboratory XRF table archive status and supplementary dependence
withdrawn_reviewer_errors.correction: Withdrawn 'unarchived 251-sample raw XRF table' and 'neither item affects any conclusion' statements. The numerical laboratory XRF table is retained (reproducibility/darkmatter/environment_inputs/geochemistry/xrf_lab_table_all_trips.tsv) and rebuilt via rebuild_environment.py; XRF units, instrument metadata, detection limits, and raw climate API responses remain unresolved, and Supplementary Note S3 exploratory claims remain conditional on them.
Withdrawn Figure 4b minor comment. Figure 4b uses vertical bars with percentage-only labels across all three groups; no figure change is needed.
Clarified that n_K * n_Q / (n_K + n_Q) is the product of group sizes divided by total stratum size (half the harmonic mean).
